title: More of your event, handled by Zuddl | Zuddl Blog
summary: Run Simulive on virtual and hybrid stages, email surveys after the event, add mobile app banners, and more. See how Zuddl takes manual event work off your plate.
body_markdown:
Running an event involves hundreds of small yet manual actions: getting attendee feedback, starting sessions on cue, or pulling up the right people onsite. This month’s updates move more of that manual work into Zuddl.


Dive in.


### Send surveys even after the event ends — via email


##### *Digital Events, Conferences*


A survey midway through the event is pushing it, a survey at the end of the event gets pushed over. It's no wonder that 58% of event surveys receive zero responses.


You can now add the survey to the “Thank you for coming” email in one click, or you can add it to a custom email. Since the survey is sent from Zuddl, the responses are tied to the attendee record on the platform, unlike surveys run on third-party tools. This feature is available across all event types - webinars/digital, in-person, and hybrid events.


#### Run Simulive sessions on virtual and hybrid stages


##### *Conferences, Digital Events*


Just like webinars, you can now run Simulive sessions on virtual and hybrid stages. Upload your Simulive recording and schedule it to the minute, with chat, polls, Q&A, and surveys working just like they do in a live session.


#### Add promotional banners to your mobile app screens


##### *Conferences*


You can now promote sponsors or offers with banners in your mobile app. Place the banners across the mobile app screens, schedule them down to the minute, and track the impressions, clicks, dismissals, and click-through rates.


#### Show or hide features within the mobile app on your own


##### *Conferences*


You can now turn off mobile app features that aren't relevant to the event (profile info, QR networking, chat, etc.) by yourself, so they don't distract your attendees. Configure it once per event, and modify it within individual sessions if needed.


#### Filter by Custom Audience Groups in the Onsite app


##### *Conferences, Field Events*


Custom Audience Groups now surface alongside the check-in and print-status filters in the on-site app. This means you can pull up VIPs who haven't checked in yet, the partners whose badges haven't been printed, and more.


With every new update and enhancement, the platform lifts the load off your event and operations teams and starts carrying its own weight. That’s a wrap for this month.
